info.description: Monitoring API that reads pre-aggregated data from state-tracker worker
info.title: DSV Pipeline Monitor API (Direct Redis)

get.description: Get network-wide aggregated batches with validator contributions
Get Level 1 (local) or Level 2 (aggregated) finalized batches. Queries last 24 hours of data (matches retention period).

parameters.description: Number of batches to retrieve (default 50, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get pre-aggregated dashboard metrics from state-tracker
Get epochs currently in progress (window open, level 1/2 in progress). Queries epoch state directly for accuracy.
Identify epochs that should have finalizations but don't

parameters.description: Window minutes to check for gaps (default 5)
parameters.name: window_minutes

get.description: Get epoch progression with phases and batch status
Get complete epoch state with all phase information
Get all submissions for a specific epoch with detailed metadata (slot ID, peer ID, project ID, CID)
Check if the API and Redis connection are healthy
Returns all heartbeat messages from the specified peer ID. Heartbeats are NOT EIP-712 signed.
get.summary: Get heartbeats from a specific peer

parameters.description: Maximum number of heartbeats to return
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns heartbeat messages received within the specified time window. Heartbeats are NOT EIP-712 signed - only peer ID is available.

parameters.description: Maximum number of heartbeats to return
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get pipeline metrics from pre-aggregated data
Get real-time queue depths and processing rates
Get all simulation messages from a specific peer (libp2p ID)
Get recent simulation messages (epoch 0 with real CIDs) from snapshotters. Simulations are sent at startup to verify connectivity and contain EIP-712 signatures.

parameters.description: Maximum number of simulations to return (default: 50, max: 500)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get simulation messages for a specific slot ID

parameters.description: Maximum number of simulations to return
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Simulations from the specified slot ID

get.description: Get all simulation messages from a specific snapshotter (EIP-712 recovered address)

Get list of epochs that have spam tracking data. Queries epochs from aggregation windows (persistent) and active epoch peer sets (ephemeral, for recent epochs not yet aggregated). Epoch peer sets are deleted after window aggregation, so this endpoint primarily returns epochs from windows.

parameters.description: Maximum number of epochs to return (default: 100, max: 1000)
parameters.name: limit

200.description: List of epochs with tracking data, each containing epoch_id and peer_count

get.description: Get list of all flagged peer IDs (from Redis cache, synced from on-chain)

200.description: List of flagged peers with metadata

get.description: Get list of all flagged snapshotter addresses (from Redis cache, synced from on-chain)

200.description: List of flagged snapshotters with metadata

get.description: Get validation failures, submission counts, and aggregation info for a specific peer
get.summary: Get spam tracking info for a peer

parameters.description: Specific epoch ID (optional, defaults to current epoch)
parameters.name: epochID

get.description: Get tracking data (submissions, validation failures) for a peer across multiple epochs
get.summary: Get epoch-by-epoch tracking for a peer

get.description: Get aggregated spam protection statistics including flagged counts, reports, and enforcement metrics

Get list of all windows that have spam reports (for discovery/indexing). Windows are created at epoch boundaries (epochID % 10 == 0) and contain aggregated reports for a 10-epoch range. Windows persist for 2 hours (TTL).
get.summary: List all aggregation windows with reports

200.description: List of windows with window_id, epoch_range (e.g., '24189511-24189520'), first_epoch, last_epoch, and peer_count

get.description: Get all peers and their aggregated reports for a specific window. Window ID is the end epoch of the 10-epoch range (e.g., window 24189520 contains epochs 24189511-24189520). Includes validator counts (consensus requires >= 2 validators), all spam reports with epoch_id, violation_type, count, and evidence.
get.summary: Get details for a specific aggregation window

parameters.description: Window ID (end epoch of 10-epoch range, e.g., 24189520 for epochs 24189511-24189520)
parameters.name: windowID

200.description: Window details including window_id, epoch_range, peers array with peer_id, validator_count, report_count, first_epoch, last_epoch, and reports array

get.description: Get pre-aggregated 24-hour statistics
Get pre-aggregated hourly statistics
Get recent events from timeline sorted sets with enriched metadata

parameters.description: Minutes to look back (default 5, max 1440 for 24 hours)
parameters.name: minutes

parameters.description: Include detailed metadata from Redis (default true)
parameters.name: include_metadata

get.description: Get priority assignment and submission status for a specific epoch. Returns combined priority and submission information including priority details and submission details if available.
get.summary: Get VPA status for specific epoch

parameters.description: Protocol state identifier (defaults to configured protocol)
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.description: Data market address (defaults to configured market)
parameters.name: market

200.description: VPA epoch status with priority and submission information

get.description: Track complete lifecycle of an epoch from release to submission, showing all stages and timing

parameters.description: Protocol state identifier (defaults to configured protocol)
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.description: Data market address (defaults to configured market)
parameters.name: market

200.description: Epoch lifecycle with all stages and timing

get.description: Get aggregated VPA statistics including total priority assignments, submission counts (success/failed), success rates, and 24-hour activity counts.

parameters.description: Protocol state identifier (defaults to configured protocol)
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.description: Data market address (defaults to configured market)
parameters.name: market

get.description: Get priority assignment and submission timeline. Returns recent priority assignments and/or submissions ordered by timestamp (most recent first).

parameters.description: Protocol state identifier (defaults to configured protocol)
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.description: Data market address (defaults to configured market)
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: Number of entries to retrieve per timeline type (default: 50, max: 1000)
parameters.name: limit

200.description: VPA timeline with priority and/or submission entries

system_metrics.description: Rates, totals, current counts (includes VPA metrics)

peer_id.description: libp2p peer ID of the sender
libp2p peer ID of the sender

snapshot_cid.description: Real CID of the computed snapshot

is_enhanced.description: Whether entity ID uses new enhanced format

stats.description: Contains priority assignments, submissions, success rates, etc.
